method: Independent source/state review and direct view_image inspection of all six final screenshots at original detail. No browser test rerun.

findings: Biceps and quadriceps share guarded controls using their selected atlas identity.
Functional state updates merge the latest anatomy state, preserving unrelated learning work and tutor profile.
Navigation, atlas, step, playback, clinical, model-focus, study-sheet, and gallery context guard against stale control actions.
Step changes retain paused activation and narrate through the single polite atomic detail.
Muscle-to-knee handoff preserves latest work and playback, opens canonical knee extension with clinical reset, and uses the existing guarded destination focus helper.
Separate activation and sarcomere SVGs retain original signal routes, cellular structures, calcium/sodium highlights, filament lengths, and moving Z discs.
Numbered marker targets match the HTML structure keys and preserved schematic orientation.
Ca2+ and Na+ text remains unchanged inside explicitly isolated LTR bdi nodes in structure keys and mechanism captions.

screenshots.review: The enlarged activation illustration has eight clearly separated numbered circles and traceable leaders. The close-up separately identifies actin, myosin and both Z discs. Keys, captions, orientation cue, controls and keyboard focus are clear, with no clipping.

The two clinical receptor crosses and dashed comparison line remain visible above signal routes. The sarcomere drawing clearly shows closer Z discs, actin and myosin. Active key outlines, clinical text and controls are readable.

At 320px, eight activation markers and three sarcomere markers stay inside their crops and match their readable keys. Long receptor and reticulum labels wrap within cards. Ca2+ remains intact; controls and current-state text are visible without overlap.

Dark HTML panels preserve text contrast and cyan selected/focus cues. The light diagram surfaces preserve cell and filament contrast. Marker circles, keys, orientation note and wrapped ion label remain clear.

The header motor-neuron introduction is now native Arabic and wraps clearly below the title, resolving MUSCLE-VIS-01. Native RTL labels, larger text, clinical explanation, controls and structure keys remain readable. The eight activation leaders and three close-up markers remain traceable; schematic orientation stays stable and Ca2+ reads correctly in its isolated LTR token.

Selected steps and structure keys retain visible system-color outlines. Keyboard focus is distinct. Monochrome legend symbols and labels remain readable, while numbered marker current states remain distinguishable.
